title: Vintage Wildflower Meadow & Honeybee Tough Phone Case | Botanical Cottagecore Dual-Layer Cover
description:
Protect your phone in premium artisan style with the Vintage Wildflower Meadow & Honeybee Tough Phone Case.

Designed for the Botanical Cottagecore collection, this case combines high-impact shock absorption with edge-to-edge full-bleed artwork that will not fade, scratch, or peel.

PRODUCT SPECIFICATIONS:
- Dual-layer protection: Impact-resistant Polycarbonate outer shell + Shock-absorbing TPU silicone liner
- Full-bleed 300 DPI sublimation printing with rich saturated pigments
- Engineered camera bezel with 35% upper safe zone protection
- Wireless charging (Qi & MagSafe compatible)
- Available for Apple iPhone & Samsung Galaxy flagship models

CARE INSTRUCTIONS:
Wipe clean with a damp microfiber cloth. Mild soap may be used if needed.
prompt: Full-bleed 9:16 vertical phone case artwork. Botanical cottagecore meadow illustration. Clustered purple echinacea, wild lavender, and chamomile daisies with golden honeybees in lower composition. Upper safe zone contains subtle antique celestial star arch on cream parchment background. Warm sage green and terracotta palette.
